scope: MoSSe S/Se, E orientation, tau_A=(1/3,2/3), fixed accepted relaxed geometry; no other materials
stage_order: For each mesh: A0/lower0/upper0 all pass; then Am/Ap/lowerm/lowerp/upperm/upperp. Any hard gate failure stops. Run9 after6. Stop after9 if band-window slopes/directions/rank remain unresolved. Otherwise run12 only if6-vs9 physical-layer C0 (5%) or G (10%) agreement fails or rank unresolved, and time/storage permits. Stop after12 regardless.
early_finish: Stop after9 if agreement/rank criteria met; never idle or add work merely to run until afternoon
layers: both new matched isolated geometries separately, no old translation-equivalence reuse
physical_readout: Pauli-spin EB term for Ex/Ey,Bz; total/lower/upper sx/sy/sz

numerical_gates.band_window_signs: must agree; no adjustment to force predicted sign
numerical_gates.band_window_G: All retained windows: G directions and layer-rank agree; C0 5%, G10% absolute differences normalized by largest physical-layer coefficient; G above twice observed half-probe error. Failure after9 stops for review, no automatic band expansion.

limits: Two/three mesh comparisons are diagnostics, not universal final convergence
No physical gate sign or layer-response sign assumed
No checkpoint auto-resume or automatic extra jobs
Per-file RLIMIT_FSIZE6GiB and post-command size checks; reserve8GiB per new state with campaign usage+reserve<=35GiB and filesystem free>=16GiB. Group quota/balance unknown.
No science or Python postprocessing on Japan login nodes
planning_time: About5-10hours for6+9 meshes; conditional12 may take total10-16hours or exhaust remaining budget. Queue delay unknown. Aim human acceptance by2026-11-11 15:00 Asia/Shanghai if dispatched around22:00; earlier completion exits immediately.
restart_provenance: WAVECAR/CHGCAR are initial guesses only, not claimed frozen in advance; actual copied input SHA256 recorded on compute node before each SCF.
PAW_hash_normalization: UTF-8 text strip of outer whitespace only; full raw copy hash also recorded in each state.
